title: E-ink frame
description: Sent as a reply to `get_screen`. Read under pwnagotchi.ui.web.frame_lock from pwnagotchi.ui.web.frame_path. Heavy over Bluetooth: on demand only.

mtime.description: Epoch seconds of the frame file.

timestamp.description: Epoch seconds at which the plugin produced the message.

message_id.description: Client-generated correlation id. When present the plugin echoes it in the reply and in the acknowledgment.
